Market today: Tech is still the main driver, but Intel's weak guidance is a big red flag for chip stocks. The mood is cautious.

Your holdings: SMCI (-21.54%), METU (-17.28%), MUU (-27.45%), SOXL (-54.44%), and SPAL (-40.52%) are all marked SELL and are bleeding. These leveraged ETFs and chip names are taking a hit. QQQI (-4.73%) and SMH (-11.74%) are also under pressure.

Watch: Intel's plunge and its impact on the broader semiconductor space.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching for further weakness in chips.
plays: Trim SOXL if it breaks below 100.
Consider trimming SMCI if it tests 30.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
